_readme: Ground truth for the eval suite. Each fixture page has one or more deliberately planted bugs. `keywords` is a list of alternatives -- a fixture's bug counts as 'found' if ANY finding on that job has tier == tier and one of these substrings (case-insensitive) in its title. This only measures recall against known-planted bugs; it does NOT auto-score precision, since that requires knowing every real bug on a page, not just the planted ones -- see agent/eval/run_eval.py's per-page 'extra findings' output for manual precision review.

planted_bugs.label: form submits with empty required field
LCP over threshold (~2.2s artificial server delay)

fixtures._note: Strict-Transport-Security is deliberately NOT in this list -- Vercel injects HSTS at the edge for every HTTPS deployment on this platform regardless of app code, so it's never actually missing here. An earlier version of this manifest wrongly expected it; confirmed via `curl -I` against the live site before removing it, not assumed.

planted_bugs.label: navigation link does not change URL or load new content
